summary: Crinetics Pharmaceuticals entered into a definitive merger agreement with Vertex Pharmaceuticals on July 6, 2026, where Clark Merger Sub, Inc., a Vertex subsidiary, will merge with and into Crinetics, leaving Crinetics as a wholly owned subsidiary of Vertex. The filing announces non-compete agreements with key executives, including CEO R. Scott Struthers, CFO Tobin Schilke, CSO Stephen Betz, and CCO Isabel Kalofonos, with aggregate cash consideration of $200,000 for three officers upon closing. No per-share price, implied value, premium, or board recommendation is disclosed; deal advisors are unnamed. The merger structure is a reverse triangular merger subject to customary conditions. What to watch: regulatory antitrust clearance and shareholder vote timing; risk-arb spread hinges on closing certainty without disclosed valuation details.
